{{Current events|year=2019|month=07|day=31|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Thirty-two civilians are killed and over 20 are injured after their bus hits a [[land mine]] on the main road between [[Herat]] and [[Kandahar]]. [https://nypost.com/2019/07/31/bus-strikes-roadside-bomb-in-afghanistan-32-killed/ (''New York Post'')]
*[[War on Terror]]
**Unnamed [[United States|U.S.]] officials say they have received intelligence that [[Hamza bin Laden]], son of [[Osama bin Laden]] and a wanted [[al-Qaeda]] terrorist, has been killed. The time, location and cause of death has not been disclosed. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/31/hamza-bin-laden-son-of-osama-bin-laden-has-died-reports (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/national-security/u-s-has-intel-osama-bin-laden-s-son-heir-n1037236 (NBC News)]

;Business and economy
*Brazilian [[Ministry of Economy (Brazil)|Minister of Economy]] [[Paulo Guedes]] announces that the full members of [[Mercosur]]—[[Argentina]], [[Brazil]], [[Paraguay]] and [[Uruguay]]—are negotiating a free trade deal with the [[United States]]. [https://www.clarin.com/mundo/brasil-anuncio-mercosur-negocia-acuerdo-libre-comercio-ee-uu_0_otwdOA_zJ.html (''Clarín'')] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-brazil/brazil-kicks-off-complex-us-trade-deal-talks-idUSKCN1UQ2V0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 wildfire season]], [[2019 Siberia wildfires]]
**[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] orders the [[Russian Ground Forces]] to join firefighting efforts to help tackle raging [[wildfire]]s in [[Siberia]]. A [[state of emergency]] has been declared in [[Irkutsk Oblast]], [[Krasnoyarsk Krai]], [[Buryatia]] and [[Sakha Republic]], where millions of hectares are currently burning out of control. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-49182554 (BBC)]
*A [[United States Navy]] [[Boeing F/A-18E/F Super Hornet|F/A-18E/F Super Hornet]] crashes in [[Death Valley National Park]], [[California]], leaving seven visitors on the ground with minor injuries. A search and rescue operation is underway for the pilot. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2019-07-31/u-s-navy-f-a-185e-jet-crashes-near-china-lake (''The Los Angeles Times'')]
*An explosion at an [[ExxonMobil]] oil refinery in [[Baytown, Texas]], hospitalizes 66 people. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/66-people-receiving-medical-attention-after-exxonmobil-refinery-explosion-texas-n1037581 (NBC News)]

;International relations
*[[United States sanctions against Iran]], [[Iran–United States relations]]
**The [[United States Department of the Treasury]] sanctions [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian Foreign Minister]] [[Mohammad Javad Zarif]] for implementing the "reckless agenda of the [[Supreme Leader of Iran]] [[Ali Khamenei]]". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-49182562 (BBC)][https://www.cbsnews.com/news/united-states-sanctions-on-iran-foreign-minister-javad-zarif-as-trump-administration-increases-tensions/ (CBS News)]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Hong Kong protests]]
**At least 10 people are injured after fireworks were shot from a moving car into a crowd of pro-democracy activists in [[Hong Kong]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-49177314 (BBC)]
